title: Director of Cybersecurity & IT
description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Back Market is looking for a Director of Cybersecurity & IT to define and lead the next phase of our security and technology operations maturity. Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be a strategic leader at the intersection of cybersecurity, IT, risk, compliance, and business growth.

You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient.

 

This is a director-level role, not a super-sized operational manager role. You will not be expected to personally own every process or make every technical decision. Your impact will come from setting direction, developing leaders, aligning stakeholders, making sound investment choices, and ensuring that the organization delivers measurable outcomes. You will be the senior voice who makes cybersecurity and IT understandable, actionable, and connected to the business.

 

To know more about our engineering teams:

  • A video of our VP Platform: https://youtu.be/zvTlw4BNNdc

  • Our company purpose: http://bit.ly/3OsScpl

  • Our engineering blog: https://bit.ly/3ASJNID

How we work with the existing teams 💚

 

The Director sets direction, creates clarity, secures resources, removes organizational obstacles, develops leaders, and ensures that the overall portfolio delivers against agreed outcomes. The functional managers and senior experts retain ownership of day-to-day execution, technical practices, operational processes, and delivery within their domains. The Director creates the conditions for those leaders to succeed and makes sure their work adds up to a coherent company-wide strategy.

Your next missions 👇

 

Set the strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities

  • Define and evolve a multi-year Cybersecurity & IT strategy aligned with Back Market's business goals, risk appetite, technology strategy, and growth plans

  • Translate that strategy into a focused portfolio of initiatives, with clear outcomes, sequencing, ownership, dependencies, and measures of success

  • Own the operating rhythm for the full scope: planning, budgeting, program tracking, KPI and SLA reporting, risk reviews, and executive communication

  • Make pragmatic investment and prioritization recommendations, balancing resilience, customer trust, regulatory expectations, employee experience, and engineering velocity

  • Establish the governance forums and decision mechanisms needed to keep priorities clear and accountability visible

 

Lead and grow a high-performing leadership organization

  • Lead through the managers and senior individual contributors responsible for Security Operations, Governance Risk & Compliance, IT Operations Engineering, IT Support, and relevant security engineering or product security capabilities

  • Coach, challenge, and develop your leaders, helping them grow their scope, judgment, influence, and ability to build strong teams of their own

  • Create clear career paths, succession plans, and development opportunities across the organization

  • Build a high-trust environment where teams have genuine ownership, collaborate across boundaries, and are encouraged to improve how work gets done

  • Attract and retain exceptional talent, define what great leadership and execution look like, and continuously raise the bar without creating unnecessary bureaucracy

  • Ensure that responsibilities, decision rights, and interfaces between the teams are explicit, understood, and respected

 

Turn cybersecurity into a business enabler

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the VP of Engineering, CTO, Executive Committee, and senior leaders across the business

  • Explain complex security, IT, and risk topics in clear business language, including the trade-offs, options, costs, and consequences of different decisions

  • Engage with Heads of and cross-functional streams across Back Market to advocate for security and resilience in all areas of the business

  • Build alignment rather than relying on authority, and help teams adopt secure and resilient ways of working because they understand the rationale and value

  • Partner with Finance and senior technology leadership on investment cases, budget stewardship, vendor strategy, and the value delivered by the portfolio

 

Steer enterprise cyber risk and trust

  • Own the cyber risk management process at the strategic level, using the GRC framework as the foundation for security decisions and prioritization

  • Ensure that material risks, control gaps, exceptions, and remediation plans are visible, understood, and actively managed

  • Escalate critical risks when they exceed the organization's risk appetite or require executive arbitration

  • Support security compliance efforts across the organization, ensuring alignment and buy-in from peers and key stakeholders across ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, and contractual partner requirements

  • Partner with the VP Legal and DPO on the company's data privacy strategy, ensuring privacy and security requirements are considered early in business, product, and technology decisions

  • Represent Back Market's security maturity and risk posture to investors, auditors, regulators, strategic partners, and major customers

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for major or complex security incidents, ensuring the right executive communication, decision-making, learning, and follow-through without displacing the operational ownership of the incident response teams

 

Enable secure products and resilient technology

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and other Bureau of Technology directors to ensure security requirements are integrated into product and feature development from the beginning

  • Sponsor and evolve Product Security and secure software development lifecycle practices, including security-by-design, threat modeling, appropriate testing, and pragmatic guardrails

  • Ensure the security roadmap addresses the most important risks across cloud infrastructure, corporate systems, identity and access, endpoints, applications, data, and third-party services

  • Set the expectations for Security Operations across threat intelligence, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident readiness, risk assessment and project design reviews, fraud support, AI security, and associated SLA and KPI tracking

  • Ensure IT Operations and IT Support provide a reliable, scalable, and high-quality experience for Back Makers across our global offices and remote workforce

  • Champion automation, standardization, and engineering-led approaches that reduce manual work and improve reliability, while leaving day-to-day technical ownership with the appropriate functional teams

 

Build security culture and external credibility

  • Foster a security-aware culture through clear communication about the evolving threat landscape, key initiatives, practical expectations, and the role every Back Maker plays in protecting the company

  • Sponsor awareness, education, and Security Champion programs that make secure behavior accessible and relevant to different audiences

  • Represent Back Market in relevant security communities, industry groups, partner forums, and regulatory conversations

  • Build trusted relationships with strategic technology partners, auditors, insurers, and external security providers

  • Help Back Market demonstrate that strong security, responsible technology, and business agility reinforce one another


You could be a good fit if you've:

  • A proven track record of building, scaling, and developing organizations that span multiple security and/or IT domains

  • 12 to 15+ years of experience across cybersecurity, information security, IT, or related technology leadership roles, including at least 5 years leading managers and multi-team organizations

  • Experience operating as a strategic partner to a CTO, VP Engineering, executive committee, or equivalent senior leadership group

  • Proven expertise and a solid grasp of the domains listed below: security operations, cyber risk and governance, compliance and assurance, security architecture, product security, cloud security, IT operations, or corporate technology

  • Demonstrated ability to turn business strategy and risk appetite into a practical security and IT roadmap, investment plan, and operating model

  • Experience communicating security and technology risk to executive, board-level, investor, partner, audit, and non-technical audiences

  • A mature, risk-based approach. You understand that perfect security does not exist, and that good leadership means making explicit, informed trade-offs and focusing resources where they have the greatest impact

  • Experience leading through managers and senior experts, with a genuine passion for developing people, building leadership capability, and creating meaningful career paths

  • Strong understanding of modern cloud, SaaS, identity, endpoint, application, data, and infrastructure security concepts, even if you are not the deepest technical expert in every domain

  • Experience with security-by-design, secure software development lifecycle practices, and effective partnership with Engineering and Product teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to make complex topics clear, concrete, and compelling. French is a plus

  • The judgment, calm, and influence required to operate effectively in ambiguity, during incidents, and across competing stakeholder priorities

  • Genuine excitement about Back Market's mission and the belief that cybersecurity and IT are essential enablers of sustainable growth

    Nice to have

  • A recognized certification such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, or an equivalent professional qualification

  • Experience with ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, or other relevant European regulatory and assurance frameworks

  • Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, modern cloud-native security tooling, or SaaS-first environments

  • Experience in marketplace, e-commerce, fintech, or another business with meaningful customer, partner, or regulatory trust requirements

  • Experience with AI security, fraud prevention, third-party risk, or software supply chain security

  • Experience working in a fast-growing, international organization with distributed

    Hiring process

    1. Phone call with Marie, Technical Talent Acquisition Partner - 45 min

    2. Deep-dive interview on cybersecurity and IT strategy with your future manager, the VP of Engineering - 60 min

    3. Leadership and management interview with a peer Engineering Director and an Engineering Manager - 60 min

    4. Meet your future team - 45 min

    5. Stakeholder interview with cross-functional partners, including the CTO and relevant Security and IT leaders - 60 min

    6. Cultural and Values interview with a C-level leader from Back Market - 45 min

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
About Payflows

At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it.

But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool.

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter.

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform, where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control.

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized.

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters.

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future.

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗

🚀 What you’ll actually do

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Design and implement new services for a product feature.

  • Refactor an early service to make it more robust.

  • Investigate a performance or production issue.

  • Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature.

  • Review code and help teammates improve.

  • Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations.

  • Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them.

Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists. Both matter.

You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production.

You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏

Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools.

  • Core language: Python

  • Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic

  • Data: PostgreSQL

  • Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense

  • Performance: some Rust for critical paths

  • Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about

Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in.

Over the next year, we’ll focus on:

  • Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents

  • Simplifying services

  • Improving tests and observability

  • Making performance more predictable

  • Cleaning up early code

We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step.


✨ Who’s going to thrive with us

You’ll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You like building products people actually use.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You’re curious and enjoy figuring things out.

  • You’re pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

This role is a great fit if you’re excited by the idea of:

  • Building systems that are used by AI agents, not just humans.

  • Designing reliable, safe automation in production.

  • Working on a product that is still early and evolving quickly.

You don’t need to know everything about AI. But you should be curious about it and excited to work in a system where agents are part of the core product 🤖

🧩 What you’ll get from this role

  • Real ownership over parts of the system.

  • Direct impact on customers and product decisions.

  • A small, human team where your work is visible and meaningful 🤝

  • A mix of feature work, system design, and technical improvements.

  • Exposure to real scaling and production challenges.

  • The chance to help build an agent-driven product from the inside.

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

title: Talent Partner (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description

We build the operating system for renewables: more than 10 GW across 8,000+ plants run on the Amperecloud Platform. Growing that requires energy expertise, and it requires exceptional people. Finding them, developing them and keeping them is what this role exists for.

As

Talent Partner (m/f/d) you work directly with our founders. You own everything talent: who we hire, how we assess, how people grow, and the culture all of it runs on.

Lead: Frederik (CEO) & Florian Strunck (COO)

Contract type: Full-time, permanent

Start: October/November
Location: Berlin

#The role

The focus is singular: talent density and the culture that sustains it. You make sure the few people we hire are exceptional, that our strong people stay and grow, and that our values remain a working standard rather than a poster.

Within that focus, you are the third voice beside the founders on people decisions: who we hire, who we promote, who we bet on, when we part ways. You read people precisely, see early where they are heading, and say it out loud in the room where it counts. No process replaces that; ours is built to support it.

The same logic extends beyond the founders: to our decision-makers you are an advisor, not an order-taker. You read the talent market and tell them what their plans will cost, you sharpen how we present ourselves to candidates, and you build pipelines for the roles we will need before we need them.

You will not start from zero. Over the past year we built our People Guild: values translated into observable behaviors, a leveling framework with Berlin salary bands, structured interviews with an independent bar raiser who holds a veto, a lean feedback cycle. You inherit the engine mid-build, documented, with deadlines and founder sponsorship. You finish it, run it, and make it yours.

#What you will do

  • Hiring: Full-cycle recruiting for few, senior, often technical roles. Outbound-first: you map markets and build pipelines from scratch rather than waiting for applications. You run the culture screen as the first interview of every process and protect the hiring bar, founders included.
  • Culture: Our ADEPT values as a working rubric. Every interview, feedback cycle and promotion scores against it, and you keep it sharp.
  • Development and retention: Leveling, salary bands, a semi-annual feedback cycle, promotion rounds, VSOP administration, retention bets on key people.
  • Tooling and automation: Our ATS contract ends next year; you pick and roll out its successor. You build automations across our ATS, Notion and Humaans so manual work keeps shrinking and your time keeps moving toward talent and culture.

#What we offer

  • People decisions at a 40-person company are company decisions, and you make them with the founders
  • VSOP participation like everyone here: if the Operating System for Renewables becomes what we are building, that stake is meaningful
  • Salary band shared in the first conversation, not after four rounds
  • Development: educational leave, a steep curve by design
  • Team & culture: regular offsites
  • Mobility & health: JobRad, up to 100% Deutschlandticket subsidy, pension plan, Wellpass/Urban Sports, childcare subsidies

Requirements

#What you bring

  • Full-cycle recruiting experience from high-paced environments: a high-growth startup or scaleup, the talent team of a VC or PE firm, or a top search firm, including senior and engineering searches you sourced and closed yourself. Years matter less than evidence: show us numbers (pass-through rates, offer-accept rate, quality of hire after 12 months).
  • AI as your default way of working, not a tool you tried. You use LLMs daily and can walk us through real workflows you built: sourcing and market mapping, structured screening support, scorecard synthesis, drafting at scale. In the interview, you will show us one, live.
  • Automation literacy: You have connected tools via APIs or no-code (Apps Script, Zapier/Make/n8n or similar) to kill manual work. You read API docs without flinching. You do not need to be an engineer; you need to think like one about repetitive tasks.
  • Evidence-based assessment: You run structured interviews and can defend a hire or no-hire with observations, not impressions. A track record of calls that aged well: hires that outperformed, hard cases you named early.
  • German employment law working knowledge: contracts, terminations, fixed terms, works-council-free environments. Enough to know when you need a lawyer, and when you do not.
  • Data fluency: strong Sheets/Excel, comfortable owning funnel and retention metrics end to end; SQL basics a plus.
  • German (C1+) and English fluent. Our contracts are German, our company language is English.
  • First-principles thinker who writes things down. Default output

The process

Exactly the one you will later run: culture screen, skill assessment with a live case (bring your AI workflows), founder final.

We evaluate based on ability and potential, independent of age, gender identity, origin, sexual orientation, disability, or religion.

description:
Du kommst aus NRW und hast Bock mit Social Media organische Reichweite aufzubauen, die direkten Einfluss auf unsere Performance hat? Du willst Kanäle nicht verwalten, sondern selbst bespielen, von der Idee bis zum fertigen Reel? Dann lies weiter.

Damit wir uns nicht missverstehen: Wir suchen keine reine Redaktionsplan-Verwaltung, die Content einplant, den jemand anderes produziert. Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Kanäle in die Hand nimmt. Du suchst die Creatorinnen, du schreibst, was gedreht werden soll, du schneidest, du postest, du antwortest und du sprichst unsere Ads ein. Und du zeigst dich selbst: in unseren Stories, vor der Kamera, mit deiner Stimme. Wenn du lieber im Hintergrund bleibst, passt es nicht. Bei uns liegt Organic komplett bei dir.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest unsere organische Präsenz, von der Idee bis zum fertigen Post. Sivara ist eine Damen-Unterwäsche- und Umstandsmode-Brand mit über 120.000 Kundinnen, unsere Community redet viel mit uns, und genau da entsteht dein Content.

  • Du bespielst Instagram und TikTok mit Reels, Stories und Posts, sodass wir präsent sind.
  • Du produzierst und schneidest selbst: aus Creator-Material und eigenen Aufnahmen baust du Videos, die unser Produkt richtig in Szene setzen.
  • Du betreust unsere Community auf Instagram und Facebook, beantwortest Kommentare und Nachrichten und erkennst dabei, welche Fragen immer wieder kommen. Aus genau diesen Fragen machst du dann Stories und Reels, die sie beantworten.
  • Du findest neue UGC-Creatorinnen, die zu uns passen, verhandelst Barter-Deals und arbeitest mit Plattformen wie Trybe, etc.
  • Du schreibst die Shootinglisten für unsere Creatorinnen, sammelst das Material ein und sortierst es so, dass wir damit arbeiten können.
  • Du stehst selbst vor der Kamera: eine Story aus deinem Alltag, ein spontanes Video aus dem Lager, eine Ansage an die Community. Und du wirkst bei unseren Ad-Creatives mit, wenn wir dich brauchen.
  • Du sprichst die Voice-Over für unsere Ads ein.
  • Du betreust unsere Affiliate- und Deal-Partner, findest neue Partner und baust den Kanal mit aus.
  • Du entwickelst, wie unsere Kanäle klingen und aussehen, schaust dir an was funktioniert hat und was nicht, und planst den nächsten Monat danach.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im Social Media Marketing oder in der Content-Produktion, idealerweise für eine Brand oder im E-Commerce.
  • Du schneidest selbst und sicher, mit CapCut, Premiere oder einem vergleichbaren Tool.
  • Du hast eine angenehme, natürliche Sprechstimme und Lust darauf, regelmäßig Voice-Over einzusprechen.
  • Du bist extrovertiert und stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera. In die Kamera sprechen, ins Mikro sprechen, dich in unseren Stories mit deinem Gesicht zeigen, ist für dich kein Problem.
  • Du erkennst Formate und Trends früh und probierst sie aus, statt darauf zu warten, dass jemand sie freigibt.
  • Du triffst im Community Management den richtigen Ton, freundlich und auf Augenhöhe, auch wenn eine Kundin genervt schreibt.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau, weil alles was du schreibst direkt bei unseren Kundinnen landet.
  • Du organisierst dich im Remote-Setup selbst und ziehst Themen durch, auch wenn niemand zuschaut.
  • Nice-to-have: erste Berührung mit Affiliate- oder Deal-Plattformen, Erfahrung im Verhandeln mit Creatorinnen und deren Managements.

Benefits

  • 100% Remote, du arbeitest, wo du willst.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich deinem Leben anpassen. Wir bewerten dich nach Leistung, nicht nach Anwesenheit.
  • Arzttermine, Workation und Ähnliches sind bei uns unkompliziert möglich, kurze Absprache reicht.
  • Flache Hierarchien.
  • Performance-Bonus für echte Ergebnisse.
  • Netzwerk: Sivara ist eng vernetzt mit den führenden D2C-Brands Deutschlands und tauscht sich täglich mit anderen E-Commerce-Brands im 8- bis 9-stelligen Bereich aus. Du bekommst Einblicke und Kontakte, die du dir sonst über Jahre aufbauen müsstest.

Bis hier durch? Dann sind wir vielleicht dein Match.

Schick mir gerne ein kurzes, ungezwungenes Anschreiben per du. Was hast du bisher gemacht, welche Kanäle oder Accounts hast du selbst bespielt, was war dein bestes Video und warum hat es funktioniert, ab wann hättest du Lust, etc.

Bitte kein 5-Seiten-Roman mit "ich bin teamfähig und belastbar", sondern lieber kurz und knapp warum du perfekt geeignet bist und ggf. ein Portfolio-Link zu deiner bisherigen Arbeit.

Ich freu mich von dir zu hören!

Beste Grüße
Kacper

title: Product Designer (Experimentation) (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission

We're looking for a designer who decides with evidence. Most design roles stop at the handover. This one does not. You will design a part of the product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and read the results yourself. If you have ever shipped a redesign and never really found out whether it worked, this is the opposite of that.

You will sit inside one product delivery leadership team, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it – not off to one side taking requests. And you will not be doing it alone: you join a group of Product Designers across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: you will be designing flows that German-speaking neighbours read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences that fit how people already live. Our product mirrors real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that feel natural to someone standing on their doorstep with one hand on their phone, not to add features because we can.
  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Take a vague ask, find the actual question underneath it, and make it explainable. A well framed problem to solve is half the battle.
  • Run the experiment, and read it honestly. Design a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome with our data team. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, which is most of them, and saying what you would do differently.
  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.
  • Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do. Polish goes where it changes behaviour, not onto every surface.
  • Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less.

Your profile

  • You practice design, and you are very comfortable with numbers. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa.
  • You have technical know-how. You need to be able to construct the pipelines and dashboards yourself, use our experimentation platform, and our design system tooling.
  • You get your own numbers. Whether through SQL, AI-assisted querying, or both, you do not wait for someone else to pull data for you.
  • You have run experiments end to end. Hypothesis, design, instrumentation, analysis, decision. Not just handing a mockup to someone who tested it later.
  • You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about.
  • You use AI as a tool already or want to. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack.
  • You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd.
  • Excellent English skills for working in our international team.

To apply, share a portfolio that shows your work by impact — at least one project walked through end to end: the hypothesis, what you designed, the result, and what you took from it. Show us how you used data to move your thinking forward, and where experimentation shaped what you built.

Nice to have

  • Experience with a marketplace, community, classifieds, or other network product.
  • Strong German, or the confidence to design in it with support.
  • Experience building or maintaining parts of a design system.
  • Comfortable writing SQL without AI assistance.

What we offer

  • Hybrid work model combining office and remote days
  • A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community
  • Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other
  • Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the nebenan.de foundation

  • 30 days of vacation per year – we also offer the possibility of workation models and a sabbatical
  • A workplace in Berlin-Kreuzberg and regular events like yoga or Lunch & Learn sessions.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction

At a glance 

  • Location & work model: Berlin, hybrid
  • Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph
  • Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware
  • Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team
  • Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must

Why this role is special 

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. 

Your first 90 days 

You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next.


Your mission

  • Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions
  • Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case
  • Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks
  • Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard
  • Plan capacity, performance  and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations


Your profile

Must-haves: 

  • Kubernetes in production – built, not just used: you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm, RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role
  • Lived SRE practice: SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call
  • Hands-on experience with GitOpsor comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus
  • Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust
  • A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround
  • A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution
Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): 
  • Harvester, KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms
  • Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN)
  • Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) and capacity/cost planning
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs
  • German language skills
Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've actually built and operated. 

You don't tick every box – or your title was never “SRE”? Apply anyway. If you've owned production systems, handled incidents and worked deeply with Kubernetes, we want to hear from you – production experience and engineering mindset matter more to us than titles or buzzwords.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

  • Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe.
  • Modern tech stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, auto-scaling, and an exciting path toward the cloud – with room to build things right.
  • AI-first mindset: We use AI as a real part of our daily work, not as a buzzword.
  • Ownership & growth: Clear responsibility, short decision paths, and the opportunity to actively shape your role.
  • Flexible work: Hybrid work model three office days per week with a focus on outcomes.
  • Strong team: Experienced engineers, an open feedback culture, and an environment where reliability is treated as a real engineering discipline.


Job Location

Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm (all Hybrid)

title: Product Owner (all genders)
description:
Deine Rolle bei uns

Digitalisierung ist kein Buzzword, sondern eine Haltung.

In deiner Rolle als Product Owner (all genders) gestaltest du digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen, die echten Nutzen schaffen – für Anwender:innen, Organisationen und anspruchsvolle Projekte.

Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Dabei denkst du nicht nur agil oder klassisch – sondern situativ das, was wirklich funktioniert.


Welche Aufgaben auf dich warten

Digitale Lösungen gestalten & weiterentwickeln

  • Du entwickelst Ideen und Zielbilder für digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen.
  • Du strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt sie gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten in umsetzbare Lösungen.
  • Du begleitest digitale Lösungen über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung.
Projekte steuern & Umsetzung begleiten
  • Du planst und koordinierst IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und behältst Ziele, Termine, Qualität und Ressourcen im Blick.
  • Du schaffst Transparenz über Fortschritt, Abhängigkeiten und offene Entscheidungen.
  • Du sorgst gemeinsam mit den Projektbeteiligten dafür, dass aus Konzepten funktionierende Lösungen werden.
Anforderungs‑ & Stakeholder‑Management
  • Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, hinterfragst und strukturierst sie und stimmst sie mit den relevanten Beteiligten ab.
  • Du moderierst unterschiedliche Interessen und führst Entscheidungen herbei.
  • Du begleitest Veränderungen und unterstützt dabei, neue Prozesse und Lösungen erfolgreich in der Organisation zu verankern.
Beraten & Wissen vermitteln
  • Du unterstützt bei der Bewertung und Auswahl geeigneter digitaler Lösungen und Technologien.
  • Du begleitest bei Bedarf Ausschreibungen, Angebotsbewertungen und Beschaffungsprozesse.
  • Du bereitest komplexe Themen verständlich auf und unterstützt Anwender durch Workshops, Schulungen und geeignete Materialien.


Was du mitbringst

  • mehrjährige Erfahrung in digitalen Projekten, IT-Projekten, Produktentwicklung oder vergleichbaren Rollen mit eigener Verantwortung.
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Nutzer, Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge.
  • Die Fähigkeit, Komplexität zu strukturieren und Entscheidungen herbeizuführen.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils mindestens C1).
  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft (50% Anwesenheit am Standort Würzburg). 


Warum du bei uns richtig bist

Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die nicht nur visionär klingen, sondern die Bauwelt tatsächlich smarter und zukunftsfähig machen – und das Ganze in Projekten und mit Kund:innen, die garantiert nicht langweilig werden. Dabei bist du von Anfang bis Ende mitten im Geschehen und hast ein Team an deiner Seite, das fachlich top ist, menschlich der Knaller und jeden Partybus das Fürchten lehrt. Wir glauben an Flexibilität statt Stechuhr, an Vertrauen statt Mikromanagement und an stabile Verhältnisse. Deshalb bekommst du bei uns eine unbefristete Festanstellung in einem familienfreundlichen Umfeld mit kurzen Wegen und schnellen Entscheidungen. Außerdem warten Team‑Get‑Aways, gemeinsame Events, Hansefit, ein dickes Benefits‑Paket und eine vernünftige Altersvorsorge auf dich.

Wir bringen Kompetenz, Verantwortung, Weiterentwicklung und Humor perfekt unter einen Helm bringt..

title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
description:
What we do

At Briink, we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video
As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering:

  1. Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. 
  2. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. 
  3. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you.
Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;)


Your role

As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer, you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals.

This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket.

You will:

  • Own product features end to end, from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement.
  • Design and build scalable backend systems, including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products.
  • Build and ship applied AI/LLM features, such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows
  • Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation.
  • Improve the robustness of our systems, strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale.
  • Work directly with users, product, and data, using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works.
  • Prototype and test new AI capabilities, turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap.
  • Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge, helping the team make better product and technical decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers, including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving.


Your profile

Technical requirements

  • Strong professional backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems.
  • Experience in a small, high-ownership product team, ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers.
  • Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end, rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation.
  • Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly).
  • Strong API, database, and systems design skills, with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products.
  • Applied AI/LLM experience: you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems.
  • A solid software-quality mindset, including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security.
  • Cloud and container experience, with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads.
  • Fluent English (C1+), both written and spoken. 
Nice to have
  • Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues 
  • Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks
  • Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems.
  • Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads.
  • Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting.
  • German language skills.
Who you are
  • Kind and collaborative: You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment.
  • Mission-driven: You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action.
  • Sharp and curious: You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems.
  • A product-minded builder: You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value.
  • Highly self-directed: You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight.
  • Pragmatic and action-oriented: You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Opinionated but open-minded: You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others.
  • Commercially aware and creative: You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed.
If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection!


What we offer

  • Competitive salary and equity, reflecting your impact and ownership.
  • Purpose-driven mission: Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent.
  • Flexible hybrid setup: Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus.
  • Trust and autonomy: Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows.
  • A genuinely high-impact role: Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation.
  • Dynamic environment: Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability.
  • Learning budget and quarterly hackathons: Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward.
  • A thoughtful hiring process: We are focused on finding the right person, and are willing to take the time needed to do so.

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.


These tasks interest you

  • Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences.
  • Investigate reconstruction robustness under partial and long-term occlusions, moving objects, and incomplete observations.
  • Develop methods to improve geometric consistency under illumination changes, low-light conditions, shadows, and reflections.
  • Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility.
  • Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results.


That makes you stand out

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field.
  • You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch.
  • You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, or multi-view vision.
  • Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial.
  • Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level). Knowledge of German is desirable but not required.

Within our standardized and transparent salary framework, the pay for this position ranges from €15.50 to €19.50 per hour and is based on various factors, such as qualifications and experience.

LiveEO transforms Earth Observation data and AI into actionable intelligence for critical infrastructure and supply-chain operators around the world. We're hiring our first Sales Engineering team lead to build and lead a truly global Sales Engineering organization, unifying our regional SE teams across North America, EMEA, and APAC into one consistent, high-performing technical sales function. This is a player-leader role for someone who has run distributed technical teams before, speaks fluently in geospatial and remote-sensing technology, has sold software-enabled services rather than pure-play SaaS, and has embedded MEDDPICC and value-selling discipline into a sales engine at scale.

You'll lead a team of regional Sales Engineers, act as the company's most senior technical voice with enterprise customers, and be the standard-bearer for how LiveEO qualifies, quantifies, and wins deals. title: Senior Consultant Search, Content & AI Visibility (SEO/GEO) (m/w/d), München
description:
Wofür wir stehen:

“We drive digital transformation end-to-end - from strategy to execution. Creating measurable progress and real impact for our clients.”
 
Stillstand? Nicht mit uns. Wir glauben: Alles ist BETA und genau darin liegt die Chance für Fortschritt. Darum hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, wagen Neues und gestalten die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden aktiv mit.
Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact.
 
Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.


Deine Aufgaben:

Deine Mission: Suche hat sich in zwei Jahren mehr verändert als in den zehn davor. Unsere Kunden, B2B Hidden Champions aus Manufacturing, Industrial Goods und Wholesale, 300 Mio. bis 5 Mrd. EUR Umsatz, merken das gerade: organischer Traffic bricht ein, obwohl die Rankings stabil sind. Recherchen beginnen immer häufiger auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode statt ausschließlich auf der Suchergebnisseite. Du machst diese Marken in klassischer Suche und in generativen Systemen sichtbar. Der Hebel dafür ist Content: Sichtbarkeit entsteht heute über Inhalte, die Suchintention treffen und zitierfähig sind, nicht über Keyword-Dichte. Du gibst die inhaltliche Richtung vor und sorgst dafür, dass die Sichtbarkeit belegbar ist, nicht behauptet.

  • Strategie über die gesamte Suchlandschaft: Du entwickelst Search- und Content-Strategien, die klassisches SEO und GEO/AI Search zusammenführen, statt sie als zwei Projekte zu behandeln. Du priorisierst nach Impact, nicht nach Vollständigkeit.
  • Technisches SEO in der Tiefe: Crawling, Indexierung, Core Web Vitals, JS-Rendering, Logfile-Analyse, internes Verlinkungs- und Informationsdesign. Du begleitest Relaunches und Migrationen so, dass danach nicht die Sichtbarkeit fehlt.
  • Content-Strategie und Entitätsarchitektur: Du entwickelst Themen-, Content- und Entitätsarchitekturen entlang der B2B Buying Journey von Awareness-Content für die frühe Recherche bis zu Deep-Content, aus dem LLMs zitieren. Du entscheidest, welche Themen besetzt werden, welche Formate es braucht und was bestehender Content leisten muss.
  • Content steuern, nicht schreiben: Du briefst unser Content-Team und die Fachexpert:innen unserer Kunden, reviewst gegen Suchintention und Zitierfähigkeit und entscheidest, was publiziert wird. Du baust Content-Audits, findest Kannibalisierung und Substanzlücken und leitest daraus einen Redaktionsplan ab, der auch in sechs Monaten noch trägt. Die Texte schreiben andere. Die Richtung gibst du.
  • AI Visibility aufbauen: Du arbeitest an konsistenter Entitätsdarstellung (strukturierte Daten, sameAs, Wikidata, Branchenverzeichnisse), an zitierfähigen Inhalten und an Präsenz in den Quellen, aus denen LLMs tatsächlich zitieren.
  • AI Visibility messbar machen: Prompt-Set-basierter Share of Voice über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode – inklusive Auswertung von GPTBot-, OAI-SearchBot- und PerplexityBot-Zugriffen in den Logfiles. Referral-Traffic aus generativen Quellen trennst du so weit, wie die Datenlage es zulässt, und dokumentierst die Grenzen der Messung offen.
  • Audits mit Konsequenz: Du führst SEO- und GEO-Audits durch, analysierst Wettbewerb und Suchintentionen und leitest daraus priorisierte Maßnahmen ab, die jemand am Montag anfangen kann.
  • Verantwortung im Retainer: Du steuerst mehrere Kundenaccounts parallel, arbeitest in vereinbarten Stundenbudgets, führst die monatlichen Reporting-Calls und Quarterly Reviews und flaggst Scope-Themen früh statt spät.
  • Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du präsentierst auf Management-Level, bist Sparringspartner:in für Marketing- und Digital-Verantwortliche und sagst auch die unbequeme Wahrheit, wenn die Lieblings-KPI nichts über das Geschäft aussagt.
  • Neugeschäft mitgestalten: Du unterstützt bei Pitches und Angeboten, schätzt Aufwände realistisch ein und bringst dein Fachthema in Kundengespräche ein, bevor das Projekt startet.
  • AI-native im eigenen Handwerk: Du nutzt LLMs und Automatisierung für Analyse, Content-Optimierung und Reporting – und weißt, wo AI-Output eine fachliche Prüfung braucht.
  • Wissen weitergeben: Du coachst Kolleg:innen und Kunden, arbeitest eng mit Content, Performance und mit deinem Analytics-Pendant zusammen und dokumentierst so, dass Setups auch nach einer Übergabe noch tragen.


Damit kannst Du punkten:

  • Erfahrung mit Substanz: Mindestens 5 Jahre in SEO – mit echter Projektverantwortung, nicht nur Zuliefern. Du hast Setups gebaut, die noch tragen, nachdem du das Projekt abgegeben hast.
  • Technisches SEO ist dein Zuhause: Du kannst ein Setup mit fünfstelliger URL-Zahl auditieren und die Findings priorisieren. Search Console inkl. API ist dein Tagestool, dazu Screaming Frog, Logfiles und eine der gängigen Suites (Sistrix, Semrush oder Ahrefs).
  • Content-Kompetenz auf Steuerungsebene: Du hast Content-Strategien für erklärungsbedürftige B2B-Themen verantwortet, inklusive Themenarchitektur, Redaktionsplanung und Qualitätssicherung. Du schreibst Briefings, die ein Redakteur versteht, reviewst Texte gegen Suchintention und Zitierfähigkeit und erkennst, wann ein Text fachlich zu dünn ist, um in generativen Antworten zu bestehen. Selbst schreiben musst du nicht.
  • GEO-Erfahrung oder GEO-Neugier: Du hast schon an AI-Sichtbarkeit gearbeitet – oder du hast dich so ernsthaft eingelesen und ausprobiert, dass du eine fundierte Meinung dazu hast. Zum Beispiel dazu, ob llms.txt überschätzt ist. Wir erwarten keine fünf Jahre Erfahrung in einer Disziplin, die es seit zwei Jahren gibt.
  • Datenkompetenz, ohne Analytics-Rolle: Du liest GA4 und Search Console sicher, kannst mit BigQuery-Exports arbeiten und formulierst, welche Messung du brauchst. Bauen muss sie ein anderer – aber du weißt, was du bestellst.
  • B2B-Verständnis: Du weißt, dass eine 9-monatige Buying Journey mit sechs Beteiligten andere Antworten braucht als ein D2C-Shop. Projekterfahrung in Manufacturing, Industrial Goods, Maschinenbau oder Wholesale ist ein Plus.
  • Analytisches Denken mit Mut zur Aussage: Du erkennst Muster und traust dich, daraus eine klare Empfehlung abzuleiten – auch wenn sie nicht die bequeme ist.
  • Kommunikation: Du erklärst einer Geschäftsführung, warum eine Entitätsstruktur eine Investition wert ist. Souverän, ohne zu vereinfachen.
  • Hands-on und geduldig mit Kundenrealität: TYPO3-Installationen von 2014, eine IT, die sechs Wochen für ein Deployment braucht, ein CMS ohne Zugriff auf die Meta-Ebene. Du kennst das und arbeitest trotzdem an Ergebnissen. Bei Unklarheiten holst du dir gezielt den nötigen Input aus dem Team und arbeitest anschließend eigenständig und zuverlässig weiter.
  • Excel beherrschst du im Schlaf
  • Sprachen: Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und sicher in Englisch.


Was wir von Dir benötigen:

Mission started?! Dann brauchen wir von Dir:   

  • Deinen CV
  • Welche Vergütung Du Dir für Deine Performance vorstellst
  • Deine Kündigungsfrist bzw. möglicher Starttermin


Warum wir?

Wir glauben: Wer viel gibt, soll auch viel zurückbekommen. Deshalb erwarten dich bei uns Benefits, die über „Extras“ hinausgehen. Sie geben dir Freiheit, Flexibilität und die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln, und machen deinen Arbeitsalltag einfach besser.

  • Teamspirit pur: Kollegiale Teams mit echtem Zusammenhalt, Hilfsbereitschaft und einer guten Portion Humor.
  • Transparente Strukturen: Flache Hierarchien und eine gelebte Open-Door-Mentalität - Austausch auf Augenhöhe ist selbstverständlich.
  • Open Vacation Policy: Neben deinen gesetzlichen Urlaubstagen kannst du dir mit unserer „Above & Beyond“-Regelung zusätzliche freie Tage gönnen.
  • Work from anywhere: Ob Home-Office oder temporär im Ausland - du entscheidest, wo du am produktivsten bist.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Großer Gleitzeitrahmen - du bestimmst deinen Rhythmus, mit Verlässlichkeit bei Kunden- und Teammeetings.
  • Modelle, die zu deinem Leben passen: Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, fix oder zeitlich begrenzt – wir finden gemeinsam die passende Lösung.
  • Spannende Projekte, innovativ, abwechslungsreich und mit steiler Lernkurve – bei uns gestaltest du echten Fortschritt mit.
  • Wachstum garantiert: Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget für Workshops, Zertifizierungen oder Coachings.
  • Karrierepfade: Auch bei flachen Hierarchien sorgen klare Strukturen für deine Weiterentwicklung.
  • Mobility & Events: Bis zu 467 € fürs Öffi- oder Deutschlandticket, regelmäßige Teamevents und Besuche von Messen & Conventions.
  • Loft-Offices: Zentral gelegen, modern ausgestattet, kreativ – mit Raum für Austausch, Ideen und natürlich Snacks & Drinks.
  • Rewards: Prämiensystem für deine persönlichen und unternehmerischen Erfolge.

Diese Position ist im Consulting Cluster von TOWA auf Senior-Level angesiedelt. Das Gehalt liegt zwischen €60.000 und €75.000 brutto/Jahr (All-in). Die angegebene Range umfasst alle Gehaltsbestandteile und ist als Zielgehalt zu verstehen (z. B. inklusive variabler Anteile oder weiterer Benefits, sofern zutreffend). Im Falle einer Zusammenarbeit erstellen wir dir ein individuelles Angebot – die Einstufung innerhalb der Range richtet sich nach deinen Skills, deinem Verantwortungsbereich und deiner Erfahrung, niemals nach deinem vorherigen Gehalt.

Im Einklang mit der EU-Entgelttransparenzrichtlinie (2023/970) und den länderspezifischen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzen veröffentlichen wir für jede Rolle die Gehaltsspanne und fragen Kandidat:innen nicht nach ihrem aktuellen oder vorherigen Gehalt. Unsere Kriterien zur Gehaltsfestlegung – Cluster, Level, Skills, Verantwortungsbereich und Erfahrung – gelten unternehmensweit einheitlich. Du kannst während des gesamten Prozesses jederzeit schriftlich weitere Informationen zur Gehaltsspanne dieser Rolle oder zu unserer Vergütungspolitik anfordern.

Chancengleichheit

TOWA stellt nach Skills und Impact ein. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Hintergrund, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung. Die Stellenbezeichnung gilt für alle Geschlechter (m/w/d).


Deine Führungskraft

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical outcome of complex space missions.  During mission contracting and requirements development, you may work with the sales engineering org to ensure mission requirements are valid and mission scope is adequately defined. Systems Engineers translate higher level requirements down to lower-level requirements, consulting and collaborating with discipline team-leads and subject matter experts where necessary.    

You will be the overall technical lead responsible for "building the right thing" and "building it right". This will include the management of system requirements, technical budgets, and sub-system interfaces.  Your responsibility extends to ensuring there is sufficient verification and testing of the system, and you will take ownership of the technical performance outcomes for the mission. You will be the mission's technical lead for both Spire-internal and external (customer, contractor, etc) teams, working collaboratively with others to resolve technical discrepancies in requirements, specifications, or system performance.   

You will also act as the technical point of contact for Spire's global customers during mission development phases and through on-orbit validation of the space systems, working with Spire project and program managers to provide effective communication where required.   

Your knowledge and experience working across multiple technical disciplines will help you coordinate Spire's technical efforts to ensure ultimate mission success. 
  

Role Responsibilities:  

  • Take overall technical ownership of Spire Space and/or Ground Systems from technical development through on-orbit verification; ensure that we are "building the right thing" and "building it right". 
  • Lead requirements management for a given mission or program - including development, validation, verification, and change management. 
  • Lead technical risk management for a given mission or program - including identification, qualification, mitigation, and resolution. 
  • Develop top-level requirements and then flow-down to lower-levels, consulting and collaborating with discipline team-leads and subject matter experts where necessary. 
  • Serve as the primary Spire technical POC to customers and contractors - communicating and advocating on behalf of internal technical teams where necessary. 
  • Serve as the customer's technical representative to Spire-internal teams - communicating and sometimes advocating for customer requirements, expectations, and experiences. 
  • Develop working knowledge of Spire's satellite platforms, operations systems, and payloads (both Spire and customer-developed) - including customer APIs and software service interfaces. 
  • Proactively communicate to program/project managers where changes in scope, requirements, expected system performance, or development outcomes impact the mission. 
  • Develop, deliver, and maintain mission documentation required to support programs or missions, including both internal and external (customer- or contractor-facing) documentation. 
  • Support the sales engineering team in the development of technical concepts and budgets, feasibility assessments, requirements, scope, and documentation needed during the sales cycle.  

Basic Qualifications:  

  • BSc in Engineering, Computer Science, equivalent STEM-related subject, or equivalent work experience. 
  • 5+ years of experience working in a technical engineering discipline (Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Controls, RF Communications, etc) or as a systems engineer for complex integrated systems. 
  • Comprehensive understanding of space systems, concepts of operations, and remote systems operation.  

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • 3+ years of experience as a space systems engineer working across engineering disciplines (Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Controls, Radio/Comms, etc) 
  • Experience developing or integrating RF and optical payloads. 
  • Experience participating in architecture and design of digital systems including ground station networks, data distribution and data processing systems, and spacecraft data handling systems 
  • Experience coordinating or leading diverse technical teams spanning multiple engineering disciplines and time zones 
  • Strong interpersonal skills for building relationships with clients and effectively communicating with other members of cross-functional teams 
  • Strong comprehension skills to enable timely understanding of complex customer requirements and identification of thorough and sometimes unique solutions 
  • Experience in satellite mission design, development, and testing with a clear understanding of major mission design trades and scope drivers (power / payload duty cycle, communications systems / data budgets, ground stations, launch and environmental loads, EMI/EMC, thermal management, etc.)  

 

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying.  #LI-MK1

title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for our first dedicated Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs, payment flows, and active bug bounties. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

  • Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

  • Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners.

  • Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

  • Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe.

Also, the HQ office is in Berlin, where the team often meets.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years in AppSec (or 3+ years plus a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership.

  • You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

  • You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS.

  • You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules.

  • You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

Your position in our team
  • Build and optimize cloud-native data pipelines on AWS — ETL/ELT and the infrastructure underneath (Aurora, Redshift, dbt, Spark/EMR, Airflow, CDC) — using AI tooling as a standard part of the workflow.

title: Account Executive
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in Germany.

This is a highly technical sales role focused on helping engineering teams adopt infrastructure and developer-focused technology.
You will own opportunities from initial engagement through close, working directly with technically sophisticated customers who expect credibility and speed.
The role combines consultative selling, technical problem-solving, proof-of-concept management, and disciplined pipeline ownership.
You will work closely with Solutions Engineers while becoming a trusted presence in customer communication channels and helping remove obstacles to purchase.
Success requires the confidence to explain complex concepts simply, challenge assumptions, and be transparent when a solution is not the right fit.
You will operate with significant autonomy in a fast-moving environment where experimentation, urgency, and customer outcomes matter.
This is an opportunity for either an experienced technical AE or a technically minded professional ready to take ownership of a sales quota.


Accountabilities
  • Own the sales process from qualified opportunity through successful close, with a strong focus on helping technical customers achieve their desired outcomes.
  • Build trusted relationships with engineers and technical stakeholders, including actively participating in customer communication channels such as Slack.
  • Manage and close inbound sales opportunities, moving prospects efficiently through the buying process.
  • Lead and coordinate proof-of-concept initiatives in partnership with Solutions Engineers, ensuring technical and commercial objectives are clearly defined.
  • Help customers troubleshoot questions and remove technical or commercial obstacles that could prevent a successful purchase.
  • Communicate honestly and transparently, including clearly explaining when a solution is not an appropriate fit.
  • Maintain a systematic approach to pipeline management, ensuring opportunities, next steps, and follow-ups are consistently tracked.
  • Navigate, improve, and contribute to internal sales and go-to-market systems and processes.
  • Experiment with new approaches to prospect engagement, deal execution, and GTM workflows, using results and customer feedback to continuously improve.
  • Move quickly and independently, identifying what needs to be done and taking action without requiring detailed direction.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience as an Account Executive, particularly in a technical B2B, SaaS, infrastructure, or developer-focused sales environment; alternatively, strong technical experience combined with readiness to take on a sales quota.
    • Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to comfortably understand API documentation, technical product concepts, and engineering workflows.
    • Experience selling to developers or engineering teams is highly desirable, with an understanding of how to build credibility with technically sophisticated buyers.
    • Strong organizational and pipeline-management skills, with a systematic approach to tracking opportunities and following through on commitments.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
    • High integrity and customer orientation, with a commitment to honest communication rather than overselling.
    • Strong sense of urgency and ability to operate at the pace of technically sophisticated, fast-moving customers.
    • Self-directed and resourceful, with the ability to take ownership and make progress without extensive supervision.
    • Curious and experimental mindset, with a willingness to test new approaches, learn from unsuccessful experiments, and adapt quickly.
    • Experience with databases, search technologies, or infrastructure software is a plus.
    • Familiarity with GTM automation tools such as Clay or n8n is advantageous.
    • Comfort working with Python, JavaScript, Linux, or major cloud platforms is a plus.
    • Willingness to prioritize correctness, customer evidence, initiative, and continuous improvement in day-to-day decision-making.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote working environment.
      • Opportunity to work from Canada, the United States, or Europe.

  • Sie treiben den Auf- und Ausbau eines wachsenden europäischen Marktsegments für die 4. Reinigungsstufe zur Spurenstoffelimination (EU und Schweiz) voran und verantworten dabei den gesamten Weg von der Priorisierung relevanter Länder und Märkte bis zum Vertragsabschluss.
  • Sie sprechen Anlagenbetreiber, Kommunen sowie Planungs- und Ingenieurbüros gezielt an und begleiten diese entlang der Phasen öffentlicher Vergabeverfahren im Bereich der Wasseraufbereitung.
  • Sie kalkulieren und erstellen technische Angebote, führen Verhandlungen und begleiten Ausschreibungsprozesse.
  • Sie beraten Betreiber und Planungsbüros zu passgenauen Anlagenlösungen und arbeiten dabei partnerschaftlich zusammen.
  • Sie bilden die Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb und Projektabwicklung und bringen Impulse zur technischen und organisatorischen Weiterentwicklung des Produktbereichs ein.
  • Sie entwickeln länderspezifische Markterschließungsstrategien vor dem Hintergrund der aktuellen regulatorischen Entwicklungen.
  • Sie repräsentieren das Unternehmen auf Fachmessen und Branchenveranstaltungen.

  • Sie verbinden vertriebliches Geschick mit echtem technischem Interesse und bringen Fachwissen aktiv in Beratung und Marktentwicklung ein.
  • Sie kommunizieren verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch für die Arbeit im europäischen Umfeld.
  • Sie überzeugen durch Kommunikationsstärke, Teamorientierung, unternehmerisches Denken und Eigeninitiative und möchten sich langfristig in einem kleinen, kulturbewussten Team verwurzeln.
