title: Engineering Manager Embedded
description:
Our mission at Qwello is to revolutionize the charging industry, we are committed to turn the world from combustion to electric. We put the customer first. We know their needs and deliver results they love. We design, build and operate charging infrastructure for the public space. We excel in simplicity, user focus and engineering excellence. We value diversity of thought, background and approaches and foster a culture of belonging. We understand that the best products are built by excellent teams, not individual superstars.

Be part of shaping the E-mobility of the future!

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Embedded team - the team that designs, builds and ships Qwello's AC charging stations, from circuit board to firmware to the production line. This is not a pure software management role. Your team of 6-8 spans embedded software, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering, and your scope runs from the firmware release train for thousands of chargers in the field, through EMC labs and Eichrecht certification audits, to the contract manufacturer's factory floor.

Our firmware is built on embedded Linux (Yocto) and EVerest, the open source EV charging stack we actively contribute to upstream. We are working with Rust, Python, C & C++. You will not be the deepest specialist in any one of these - your tech leads are - but you must be technical enough to represent the team when they are not in the room, to challenge estimates, and to make trade-offs between firmware, hardware and regulatory constraints with confidence and competence.

If you have led embedded or hardware-adjacent teams, enjoy being the person to which a factory, a certification body and a firmware engineer all escalate in the same week, and who brings the self-organization to keep all of it moving without dropping balls, we would love to talk.

Please Note: Tell us about a physical product you helped ship - what your team built, what went wrong on the way to production, and what your part in fixing it was.


Your Responsibilities 🚀
  • Lead and grow a team of 6-8 engineers across embedded software, electrical and mechanical engineering: 1:1s, performance reviews, compensation input, hiring and, when needed, structured performance management
  • Own delivery: quarterly planning and OKRs with leadership, translating requests from our country organizations into scoped, estimated engineering work, and saying no with a rationale when needed
  • Own the firmware release train (dev, canary, production) for the charger fleet and be answerable for fleet-impacting incidents alongside our operations teams
  • Drive certification and compliance as a permanent workstream: Eichrecht (Modul B and Modul D), CE and EMC campaigns, VDE and TÜV interactions, DSO assessments and upcoming regulation and technologies like vehicle-to-grid (V2G), changes to the AFIR and such
  • Manage key vendors and partners across the full bill of materials: our EVCC board supplier, meter vendors, payment terminal providers, the contract manufacturer running our production line, and our open source partners upstream
  • Keep production shippable: end-of-line testing, BOM changes and cost analysis, supply chain risk, and same-day escalation support when the factory line stops
  • Build a resilient team structure: develop tech leads, keep yourself off the critical path of IC work, and reduce bus factor on certification and hardware knowledge

    • Your Profile ✨
  • Several years of experience managing embedded, firmware or hardware-adjacent engineering teams, including hiring, performance reviews and difficult personnel conversations
  • A solid engineering background in embedded systems: you have shipped firmware or devices to production and can hold a technical argument with strong, opinionated senior engineers
  • Comfort with the physical side of the product: electronics, EMC, test labs, manufacturing. You do not need to design circuits, but this world must not be foreign to you
  • Demonstrated experience working with certification bodies, notified bodies or regulated products - or the appetite and rigor to own this quickly
  • Outstanding self-organization: this role has many parallel threads (people, releases, audits, vendors, factory), and following through reliably is the single most important skill
  • A track record of building self-managing teams: delegating, developing tech leads and staying off the critical path rather than being the hero
  • Excellent communication skills in English, from firmware engineers to executives to external auditors

    • Nice to have
  • German language skills - a significant part of our supplier, certification and authority communication runs in German
  • Experience in EV charging or e-mobility: OCPP, ISO 15118, Eichrecht, smart charging
  • Familiarity with embedded Linux (Yocto), EVerest or other open source involvement, Rust or modern C++
  • Experience working with contract manufacturers and owning production or end-of-line testing
  • Experience managing multi-generation products (legacy fleet plus new platform in parallel)

    • Your Benefits 🪴
  • Flat hierarchies with efficient decision-making processes without red tape
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping the mobility revolution
  • Work on products that have a direct impact on the future of sustainable transportation
  • Be part of an international and dynamic team of more than 30 nationalities
  • Enjoy a flexible hybrid setup — choose how you want to split your time between our Munich office and working from home, with the possibility of workation within the EU, plus 30 vacation days
  • Regular company and team events outside of the office to disconnect from our computers and reconnect with colleagues on hikes, mountain e-bike tours, offsites and more
  • Personal and professional development through in-house Lunch & Learn sessions, collaborative knowledge sharing, as well as externally provided training, courses and conferences

description:
Staff Backend Engineer – Platform 

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech 

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. 

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

About the role 

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. 

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. 
  • Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. 
  • Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. 
  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. 
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. 
  • Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. 

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). 
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. 
  • Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. 

 

What you'll bring to the team 

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. 
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. 
  • A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. 
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). 
  • Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). 
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. 
  • Fluent English. 

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). 
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). 
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. 
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. 
  • Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. 
  • Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. 
  • A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. 
  • Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 
  • 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. 

 

Where you'll work from 

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

BEI UNS WIRST DU:

  • Schulungs- und Awareness-Formate entwickeln, die wirklich gelesen werden – von Microlearnings über die Intranet-Gestaltung bis zu Onboarding-Unterlagen.

title: Senior Implementation Specialist Digital Analytics (w/m/d)
description:
Your new team:

As an Implementation Specialist, you are right at the heart of our projects: You translate business requirements into robust technical tracking solutions, implement them, ensure their quality, and turn concepts into fully functioning digital analytics setups. You take full responsibility for digital analytics implementations from initial requirements through to go-live and act as a trusted advisor to our clients throughout the process.


What awaits you:

  • You analyze our clients’ requirements and translate business and analytics use cases into technically sound tracking and implementation concepts.
  • You develop and document tracking concepts, data models, and data layer requirements and align them with clients and developers.
  • You work with tag management systems, implement tracking and third-party tags, and ensure scalable data collection.
  • You conduct technical testing, debugging, and data validation and systematically investigate data quality issues.
  • You consider consent management, data protection, and technical requirements from the very beginning of the implementation process.
  • You work closely with Digital Analysts, Data Engineers, and Project Managers, acting as the technical interface between business and development.
  • You actively share your expertise within your team and help develop our standards, best practices, and ways of working.
  • Depending on the project, you may also support tool selection, architecture decisions, migrations, and the technical enablement of our clients.


What you can expect:

At FELD M, you won’t work within a traditional agency structure with rigid specializations. We bring together different disciplines and perspectives and see ourselves as The Data Collective.

You will have the opportunity to work with a diverse range of clients, industries, and technology setups while continuously expanding your expertise. We deliberately work independently of specific tools while bringing many years of expertise and strong partnerships with, among others, Google and Adobe. Our projects range from auditing and optimizing existing implementations to complete new implementations and migrations, as well as complex analytics and data setups.

You also won’t work in isolation: At FELD M, the close connection between business, analytics, and technology is at the core of what we do. This intersection is what makes the role particularly exciting.

What else? We believe in People First and Sustainable Pace. Taking responsibility and delivering high-quality work does not mean constantly operating at full speed. We want to do great work sustainably – together, with mutual support and room for different lifestyles.We are looking for people who are curious, take ownership, and enjoy sharing their expertise. We don’t see job descriptions as rigid checklists. Instead, we want to understand how your experience, interests, and strengths fit the role and what we need as a team.


What you bring along:

  • You don’t need to know every tool. What matters more is that you have a strong understanding of digital analytics and can quickly familiarize yourself with new technologies and setups.
  • Several years of professional experience in digital analytics, web analytics, tracking, or MarTech implementation
  • Strong knowledge of at least one tag management system
  • Experience designing and implementing data layers and tracking concepts
  • A solid understanding of client-side and server-side tracking, as well as their respective technical requirements and capabilities
  • A solid technical understanding of web technologies, particularly JavaScript
  • Experience with testing and data validation of analytics implementations
  • An understanding of consent management, data protection, and the technical implications for tracking
  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders
  • A structured, analytical, and quality-oriented approach to your work
  • A genuine interest in taking ownership and not just analyzing technical challenges, but implementing solutions yourself
We look forward to meeting you!

title: Procurement Director (m/f/d)
description:
About HOLY

  • HOLY is the soft drink revolution: With our powdered drinks HOLY Energy®, HOLY Hydration®, HOLY Iced Tea®, HOLY Milkshake® and HOLY Syrup Bottle® you get amazing taste across 50+ flavors while maintaining a good conscience—for your body & the environment.
  • Over 2M loyal customers: Started in a shared apartment by three best friends, we have scaled to Europe's fastest growing consumer brand—and our cult-like community, the HOLY Squad, loves it: 4.6 stars on reviews.io speak for themselves.
  • From D2C to Global Omnichannel: In less than four years, we've profitably scaled HOLY to more than €180M D2C revenue in DACH, FR, UK and PL. Now scaling our retail business, we're on an exciting transition to becoming a true omnichannel rocketship.
  • We are still just getting started: Backed by the world's best consumer investors, we aim to revolutionize the soft drink industry and build a generational love brand: tastier, healthier & more sustainable. Our team of 170+ people aims high (Coca-Cola, we're coming for you!).


About the Position

As Procurement Director, you will build one of HOLY's most important competitive advantages: a world-class supplier ecosystem that enables us to scale faster, improve margins and consistently deliver outstanding products to our customers.

Procurement at HOLY is far more than buying ingredients. You will own our sourcing strategy across ingredients, packaging, merchandising and co-manufacturing while continuously improving cost, quality, supplier performance, flexibility and speed.

This is a highly strategic leadership position reporting directly to our COO, Markus. You will work closely with Product Development, Supply Chain Planning, Operations, Finance and our founders to build supplier partnerships capable of supporting HOLY's ambitious growth journey toward becoming a global consumer brand.

We are not necessarily looking for a traditional procurement leader. We are looking for an exceptional builder with outstanding commercial judgment who enjoys solving complex business problems and creating long-term competitive advantages.

If you combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset, thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy building things from scratch, this role is for you.

Responsibilities: 

Strategic procurement

  • Own HOLY's sourcing strategy across ingredients, packaging, merchandising and co-manufacturing
  • Develop category strategies that improve competitiveness, resilience and long-term scalability
  • Drive structural COGS improvements through strategic sourcing, commercial excellence and value engineering
  • Identify new sourcing opportunities, technologies and supplier capabilities to strengthen HOLY's competitive position
  • Build long-term strategic partnerships with HOLY's key suppliers
  • Develop suppliers across capacity, quality, innovation, flexibility and operational excellence
  • Ensure our suppliers scale alongside HOLY's ambitious growth plans
  • Establish HOLY as a preferred customer through trust, transparency and professional supplier management
  • Strengthen our supplier ecosystem through selective onboarding of new partners and pragmatic multi-sourcing where it creates value
Supply Chain & Operational Excellence
  • Improve end-to-end supply chain performance by reducing lead times, increasing supplier responsiveness and improving planning reliability
  • Partner closely with Supply Chain Planning and Operations to align supplier capabilities with demand forecasts, inventory targets and growth plans
  • Improve working capital through stronger commercial terms, better supplier collaboration and optimized replenishment models
  • Support the development of a scalable and resilient manufacturing network
Supplier Performance & Quality
  • Own supplier performance across quality, OTIF, responsiveness, compliance and continuous improvement
  • Establish structured Supplier Business Reviews, measurable KPIs and clear accountability with strategic suppliers
  • Proactively identify and mitigate supply risks before they impact the business
  • Ensure suppliers consistently meet HOLY's quality, food safety and regulatory standards
Leadership & Organization Building
  • Lead and develop HOLY's Strategic Procurement and Operational Buying teams
  • Build a high-performance organization with strong commercial capabilities, clear ownership and a continuous improvement mindset
  • Develop future leaders and continuously raise the maturity of HOLY's procurement function
  • Build scalable processes, systems and ways of working that support HOLY's growth


About You

We care more about your ability to solve complex business problems than about having followed a traditional career path.

You might come from Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supply Chain, Operations, Strategy Consulting, Commercial or another highly analytical business function.

Ideally, you bring several of the following experience & expertise:

  • 5–10+ years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Consulting, Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial or another analytical leadership role
  • Outstanding structured problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex challenges into pragmatic solutions
  • Strong track record of leading and developing teams 
  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth or entrepreneurial environments where ownership and speed matter
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience negotiating with suppliers, partners or senior stakeholders
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional initiatives and deliver measurable business impact
  • Experience building scalable processes, organizations and ways of working
  • Exposure to manufacturing, FMCG, food & beverage or consumer goods is beneficial but not required
  • Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus but not required) 
Mindset & Qualities: 
  • You are a builder who enjoys creating structures, teams and processes from scratch
  • You combine strategic thinking with strong execution skills and are comfortable getting hands-on
  • You have exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities and can quickly structure complex situations
  • You take ownership, move fast and thrive in environments with high autonomy and ambiguity
  • You build trust easily and can influence suppliers, stakeholders and teams through strong communication and judgment
  • You are commercially minded and always look for ways to create measurable business impact


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
  • Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY’s internationalisation in a top market.
  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over 2.5 million customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauerberg, flexible working hours, and much more.
  • Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity—giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
  • How we support your growth: flexible hours, 28 vacation days, 30 work-from-abroad days, €1,500 learning budget, Urban Sports Club membership, public transport subsidy, and biannual 360° feedback tied to your compensation.
Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.


The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

  1. Getting to know you: A 30-minute introductory conversation with Lutza, our Talent Acquisition Lead to get to know each other and discuss your experience, motivation and the role.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A deep-dive discussion with Markus, our COO about your experience, leadership style and how you approach complex business challenges.
  3. Case Study: You will receive a business case to demonstrate your strategic thinking, analytical approach and ability to solve real HOLY challenges.
  4. Advanced Discussion in our office, the HOLY Temple: Present and discuss your case with key stakeholders while getting to know our team and our way of working.
  5. Founder Interview: A final conversation with Fredi, one of HOLY's founders to ensure a strong mutual fit.
  6. Offer & Decision: If everything aligns, we will make you an offer and hopefully welcome you to the HOLY team.
Typically, this process takes around 2–3 weeks.

title: Qualitätsmanager (m/w/d) - Lieferantenqualität & Produktprüfung
description:
Es ist Feierabend und du verlässt das Office, happy und mit einem starken Gefühl. Dein erster Tag bei PRESCH war einfach stark 🔥

Du hast dir das Sortiment angesehen: über 500 aktive Artikel, vom Hammer bis zum Säbelsägeblatt, Lieferanten über halb Asien verteilt, Verkauf in mehr als zwanzig Länder. Und du hast sofort gesehen, wo das System noch fehlt. Nicht weil hier niemand hinschaut — sondern weil bisher niemand die Aufgabe hatte, aus einzelnen Prüfungen eine Systematik zu machen.

Genau das wird deine Aufgabe. Wir erweitern unsere Qualitätssicherung deutlich, weil wir immer mehr eigene Produkte entwickeln. Du bekommst keine fertige Struktur vorgesetzt, du entwirfst sie 💪

Und du merkst schnell: Hier wird nicht geredet, hier wird gemacht. Kurze Wege, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, Entscheidungen am selben Tag.

Aufgaben

🛠️ Du gibst frei — oder eben nicht. Vor jeder Verschiffung kommt ein Muster aus der laufenden Produktion zu dir. Du prüfst nach Maß, Werkstoff, Oberfläche und Funktion, dokumentierst das Ergebnis im Erstmusterprüfbericht und entscheidest, ob die Ware rausgeht. Ohne dein Ja bewegt sich nichts.

🛠️ Du baust die Prüfsystematik auf. Prüfvorschriften je Warengruppe und je Artikel, Stichprobenumfang und Annahmezahlen nach AQL, Freigabemuster als verbindlicher Vergleichsmaßstab, Rückverfolgbarkeit von jedem Befund zu Charge und Lieferant. Reproduzierbarkeit ist der Anspruch: Dieselbe Prüfung muss in zwei Jahren dasselbe Ergebnis liefern.

🛠️ Du prüfst nach, was tatsächlich angekommen ist. Wenn die Charge im Lager eintrifft, kommt ein Muster daraus zu dir und wird gegen das verwahrte Freigabemuster abgeglichen. Genau hier fallen die Fälle auf, in denen etwas anderes geliefert wurde als freigegeben. Denn nicht nur die erste Lieferung muss stimmen, sondern die zwanzigste auch.

🛠️ Du prüfst über das gesamte Sortiment. Handwerkzeug vom Hammer über Schraubendreher, Zangen und Schlüssel bis zu Messwerkzeug und Schutzausrüstung. Und Elektrowerkzeug-Zubehör: Bohrer, Bits, Säbelsägen-, Stichsägen- und Kreissägeblätter, Schleifmittel. Handwerkzeug beurteilst du statisch, Zubehör nur unter Last — mit definiertem Prüfwerkstoff und Abbruchkriterium, damit Standzeiten vergleichbar bleiben.

🛠️ Du machst Qualität messbar. Fehlerquoten je Lieferant, Warengruppe und Charge, Reklamations- und Rückläuferquoten je Artikel, qualitätsbezogene Lieferantenbewertung. Damit im Einkauf mit Zahlen entschieden wird und nicht mit Eindrücken.

🛠️ Du gehst Kundenfehlern auf den Grund. Reklamationen, Rückläufer und Produktbewertungen sind die schnellste Qualitätsmeldung, die wir bekommen — schneller als jeder Lieferantenbericht. Du liest sie als Befund, ordnest sie der Charge zu und schließst den Kreis zum Lieferanten.

🛠️ Du steuerst unsere externen Prüfinstitute. Wo eine Norm eine akkreditierte Prüfung verlangt — VPA, TÜV, VDE — holst du Angebote, beauftragst, verfolgst Termine und bewertest die Berichte. Du behältst den Überblick, welche Norm für welche Warengruppe gilt.

🛠️ Du richtest unsere Prüfwerkstatt ein. Prüfplätze, Messmittel, Prüfwerkstoffe, Prüfmittelverwaltung mit Kalibrierintervallen. Du entscheidest mit, mit welchem Equipment du arbeitest.

🛠️ Du arbeitest mit unserem QC-Officer in Asien zusammen. Er prüft vor Ort in den Werken, du bewertest seine Berichte und gibst die Prüfanforderungen vor. Zwei Kontrollpunkte, ein System.

Dein Impact nach 12 Monaten

🛠️ Es gibt eine Prüfsystematik, nach der auch jemand anderes prüfen könnte — mit Prüfvorschriften, AQL-Niveaus und Freigabemustern für die wichtigsten Warengruppen.

🛠️ Keine Sendung verlässt die Produktion ohne dokumentierte Freigabe. Und die Prüfung ist trotzdem kein Nadelöhr.

🛠️ Jeder Befund ist zu Charge, Lieferant und Produktionszeitraum zurückverfolgbar.

🛠️ Es gibt ein monatliches Qualitätsreporting, das im Einkauf tatsächlich benutzt wird.

🛠️ Reklamationen und Rückläufer sind messbar zurückgegangen, weil Fehler bei dir auffallen und nicht beim Kunden.

🛠️ Die Prüfwerkstatt steht, inklusive Verschleißprüfung unter Last.

Qualifikation

🛠️ Technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister, oder ein technisches Studium. Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Qualitätsmanagement oder vergleichbar — die Richtung ist offener als du denkst, die Praxis zählt mehr als der Abschluss.

🛠️ Zwei bis fünf Jahre in Qualitätssicherung oder Qualitätsmanagement. Idealerweise in einem Unternehmen, das beschafft statt selbst fertigt, mit internationalen Lieferanten.

🛠️ Erstbemusterung, Prüfplanung und AQL sind für dich keine Abkürzungen, sondern Alltag. Du hast schon Erstmusterprüfberichte geschrieben und Annahmezahlen festgelegt.

🛠️ Du verstehst Werkzeug als Anwender. Du hast selbst gebohrt, gesägt und geschraubt und weißt, wie sich ein gutes Werkzeug anfühlt. Ohne das bleibt jede Beurteilung eine Zahl ohne Bedeutung.

🛠️ Reproduzierbarkeit ist dein Anspruch, nicht deine Pflicht. Du hältst fest, was du feststellst — Messwert, Bild, Bedingung, Urteil. Weil ein Befund nur dann etwas wert ist, wenn er sich in zwei Jahren noch nachvollziehen lässt.

🛠️ Du bleibst standfest. Eine Sperrung hält Ware auf, und dann wird es unbequem. Wer im Zweifel freigibt, um Ruhe zu haben, macht in dieser Rolle den teuersten Fehler.

🛠️ KI ist dein tägliches Werkzeug. Wir arbeiten damit im ganzen Unternehmen. Wenn du damit schon Auswertungen, Vorlagen oder Abläufe gebaut hast, passt du gut zu uns.

🛠️ Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Du sprichst direkt mit unseren Herstellern und liest Prüfberichte im Original.

Bonus: Erfahrung mit asiatischen Lieferanten. Erfahrung mit Messmitteln wie Messschieber, Härteprüfung oder Drehmomentprüfung. Kenntnis der Normen für Werkzeug und Elektrowerkzeug-Zubehör. Erfahrung mit Verschleiß- und Standzeitprüfungen. Erfahrung im Aufbau eines QM-Systems oder einer Prüfstelle. Und wenn du eine Prüfvorschrift oder ein Prüfkonzept mitbringst, das du selbst geschrieben hast — zeig es uns. Wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst, nicht nur was im CV steht.

Benefits

🛠️ Du baust die Funktion auf, nicht nur den Prüfplatz. Prüfsystematik, Kennzahlen, Lieferantenbewertung, Prüfwerkstatt — du entscheidest, wie Qualität bei PRESCH funktioniert. Bei weiterem Wachstum wird daraus ein eigener Bereich mit Team.

🛠️ Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Kein Konzern-Reporting, keine Zwischenebene. Du berichtest direkt und bekommst Entscheidungen am selben Tag.

🛠️ Deine Freigabe hat Gewicht. Ohne dein Ja geht keine Ware raus. Das ist Verantwortung, die man nicht in jeder Qualitätsstelle bekommt.

🛠️ Gleitzeit. Du willst Job und Familie die gleiche Zeit widmen und sehnst dich daher nach einem flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodell? Kein Problem! Wir integrieren die Arbeit in unser Leben und nicht andersherum.

🛠️ Homeoffice-Tage für die Schreibtischanteile deiner Arbeit — Auswertungen, Prüfvorschriften, Reporting. Geprüft wird vor Ort, alles andere in Absprache mit dem Team.

🛠️ Du willst dich weiterentwickeln — Qualitätsmanagement, Messtechnik, Normenwissen, Auditorenqualifikation? Alles klar, dann los! Wir legen großen Wert auf deine Weiterbildung und schaffen den finanziellen und zeitlichen Rahmen dafür.

🛠️ Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit unserem Zuschuss.

🛠️ 30 Tage Urlaub.

🛠️ Mitarbeiterrabatt auf unser komplettes Werkzeugsortiment.

🛠️ Unsere Hierarchien sind flach, der Zusammenhalt ist groß: Wir feiern unseren Erfolg. Wissensaustausch, Glühweinabende, BBQ und regelmäßige Teamevents erwarten dich bei uns. Getränke sind selbstverständlich dabei.

Wenn du Qualitätssicherung nicht verwalten, sondern aufbauen willst — dann freuen wir uns auf dich!

title: Senior Avionics System Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

We are looking for an Avionics Systems Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases.

The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you might be assigned to different avionics systems of the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture

  • Define and develop avionics system architectures, including electronics, data handling, and communication functions.

  • Ensure end-to-end consistency of data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements.

  • Support selection and definition of avionics equipment, computing platforms, sensors, and communication hardware.

  • Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost.

Communications & Data Handling

  • Define onboard and ground-related communication and data handling concepts.

  • Support implementation of telemetry, telecommand, and data distribution architectures.

  • Ensure reliable data acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission under mission constraints.

  • Contribute to bandwidth, timing, and data budget analyses.

Integration & Interface Management

  • Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.).

  • Ensure compatibility between spacecraft, launch vehicle, and ground segment interfaces.

  • Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders.

External Regulatory & Certification Leadership

Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification.

Verification & Validation

  • Define and support verification and validation strategies for avionics systems.

  • Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities.

  • Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions.

  • Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements.

Requirements Engineering

  • Capture, analyze, and manage system and subsystem requirements.

  • Ensure full traceability from mission objectives to implementation and validation.

  • Contribute to system documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and test plans.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and engineering best practices.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with software, hardware, systems, operations, and mission engineering teams.

  • Participate in design reviews, technical exchanges, and system trade-off discussions.

  • Support alignment with external partners, suppliers, and customers.

  • Contribute to integration campaigns, launch preparation, and mission operations support.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent.

  • +7 years experience in avionics systems, electronics, embedded systems, or spacecraft engineering.

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Electronic and embedded system architectures

    • Communication and data handling principles

    • System integration and interface management

  • Experience with requirements engineering and system lifecycle development.

  • Knowledge of verification and validation methods, including testing and simulation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in spacecraft avionics or aerospace systems.

  • Familiarity with space communication and data standards (e.g., CCSDS).

  • Experience with HIL testing, simulation environments, or digital engineering tools.

  • Exposure to safety-critical or mission-critical system development.

  • Experience working in international or multi-stakeholder engineering teams.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (all genders)
description:
Sunday Natural is one of Germany’s fastest-growing natural health brands, and our eCommerce platform is growing with it – today it serves 7 million monthly active users, runs on €400k of AWS per year, and supports a development organization of 30+ engineers. Every one of those numbers has moved sharply upward in the last few years, and all of them will keep moving.

You would be our first dedicated in-house Senior DevOps Engineer – and the two biggest engineering projects of the next two years are yours to help define and drive: bringing our entire infrastructure under Terraform, and strengthening the scalability, security and compliance posture across our cloud environments.

Your role

  • You shape the infrastructure vision. How we run, deploy, monitor and scale is yours to define, propose and defend.

  • You work alongside our two external partners as the in-house technical counterpart – building the architecture and standards together, and bringing the deep platform knowledge back into the company. As the platform grows, taking the technical direction of that group is a natural next step, and one we would actively support.

  • You own our AWS spend – €400k a year that currently has no dedicated owner, including where it goes and how we bring it down.

  • You are the escalation point. When production is at risk, you decide.

  • You report directly to the Head of eCommerce Platforms, with direct access to leadership for the decisions that need it.

What you'll own

  • AWS infrastructure – EC2, RDS, Fargate, CloudFront, S3, IAM – plus Cloudflare, DNS and WAF

  • Security & compliance – DevSecOps practices, system audits, patching and access reviews, and GDPR-compliant data handling across every environment

  • Infrastructure as code – taking us from manually managed to fully Terraform-defined

  • Data layer – MySQL under production load: tuning, replication, and backups you have actually restored from

  • Cloud economics – a €350k annual AWS budget with real headroom for optimisation

  • Delivery for 30+ developers – Bitbucket Pipelines, environments, and how fast and safely code reaches production

  • Reliability at 7M MAU – monitoring, logging, alerting and incident response (New Relic, Sentry, CloudWatch, PagerDuty)

Your profile

  • 7+ years running production infrastructure, with deep hands-on AWS as the person accountable when it breaks

  • Security-conscious infrastructure operations – DevSecOps practices, system audits and access reviews, comfortable being accountable for GDPR-relevant data handling

  • Infrastructure as code at scale – Terraform as your default way of working, on an estate of comparable size

  • Deep Linux (Debian/Ubuntu) – you can trace a slow system from the kernel up and explain what you found

  • MySQL under real load – slow-query analysis, replication, indexing, tested recovery

  • Ownership of monitoring and incident response at scale – you have built the alerting that catches problems before customers report them, using tooling like New Relic, Datatog, etc. and run the on-call and post-incident process around it

  • Experience defining standards that other engineers work to, whether with in-house teams or external partners, and holding the line on them

Nice to have

  • PHP-FPM / Magento 2 performance tuning, or Varnish and Redis at scale

  • Cloud cost optimisation at six-figure annual spend

  • AWS architecture certification

  • Experience with SIEM tooling (e.g. Wazuh) or similar security monitoring

  • Background in direct-to-consumer eCommerce or other high-traffic system operations

Our stack

Magento 2 · PIM · PHP · MySQL · Redis · Varnish · Docker · AWS · Terraform · Bitbucket Pipelines · New Relic · Sentry · CloudWatch · PagerDuty · Cloudflare

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

We are looking forward to your application!

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

title: FullStack Engineer - Prospect UI Solutions
description:
About You

You have a knack for solving intricate Software Development problems. You're driven by the idea of writing code that simplifies life for millions of users globally. You're committed to continuous learning and enjoy tackling new challenges. Pair programming, code reviews, and collaborative brainstorming with a team are activities you find fulfilling. You're eager to work alongside developers, prospective customers, account executives, product managers, data scientists, and data analysts. You're a disciplined professional who consistently delivers high-quality code that you take full ownership of, communicates technical solutions with clarity and empathy, and takes the initiative to streamline processes for your team and yourself.

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built on a unique GPT-based architecture made specifically for commerce. Constructor's AI-first solutions make it easier for shoppers to discover products they want to buy and for ecommerce teams to deliver highly personalized experiences, from search, to recommendations, to AI Shopping Agents and everything in between. Optimizing specifically for ecommerce metrics like revenue, conversion rate and profit, Constructor generates consistent $10M+ lifts for some of the biggest brands in ecommerce, such as Sephora, Petco, Under Armour, home24, Birkenstock and The Very Group. Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

About the Position

As a Software Engineer on the Prospect UI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in proving how Constructor will enhance the website discovery experiences for prospects. You’ll work closely with internal Engineering, Product and Sales stakeholders to seamlessly integrate prospective customer data with our services, supporting them to create an optimized and accurate product discovery demo.

In this role, you will:

  • Fuel our proprietary AI models: Write JavaScript code to collect data essential for training our AI.

  • Leverage Modern Tooling: Utilize AI as a tool to accelerate your fundamental capabilities and knowledge on how to solve problems with software; building solutions that you are proud to call your own

  • Seal the deal: Collaborate with Data Analysts and Account Executives to secure deals with prominent e-commerce brands.

  • Leverage your tech knowledge: Assist prospects in integrating their data and user interfaces with our services, focusing on ETL and front-end integrations.

  • Deliver excellence: Validate the data provided by prospects and ensure the quality of the results returned by our services.

  • Empower a sales force: Contribute to the development and scaling of demo infrastructure to enhance the demo capabilities of the Sales team.

  • Be a part of the answer: Assist Account Executives by addressing technical inquiries from prospects about our services.

  • Elevate the team: Provide support to your teammates through thoughtful code reviews and empathetic problem solving sessions.

  • Visualize brilliance: Develop dashboards and alerts using React, Redux, Node, Clickhouse and OpenSearch.

  • Innovate with purpose: Implement and test new features for our open-source JavaScript UI libraries and REST clients.

  • Collaborative contribution: Steer cross-team efforts to ensure our prospect's needs are at the forefront of our priorities, making you a key player in our strategic success.

  • Champion team culture: Actively foster our team’s sense of community by expanding our roster of Friday team-building games and promoting a culture of empathy, personal growth, and support for others.

This role is ideal for any Software Engineer passionate about search technology, customer-focused solutions, and collaborative development.

Requirements

  • A minimum of four years of professional experience or relevant academic experience

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • English on C1 level (CEFR) or higher

  • Being able to attend regular meetings with teammates between 1400 and 1800 UTC, with working hours ideally starting some time in the range of 0900 and 1200 UTC.

  • Strong foundation and experience with server-side and client-side programming languages

  • Enjoys interacting with customers and solving new problems daily

  • Able to pick up new technologies and design patterns quickly and loves learning them

  • Experience with building User Interfaces utilizing front-end frameworks like (but not limited to) React, Vue or Angular

  • Proven track record of building UIs with heavy consideration for friendly user experience

  • Experience with automated tests like (but not limited to) Cypress, Jest, or React Testing Library

  • Experience in JavaScript will be a strong asset for this role, but candidates with a proven Software Development background that demonstrate a willingness to quickly learn the language will also be considered

  • Nice to have - TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind, Storybook, Python and web scraping experience

Benefits

  • 🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

  • 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

  • 🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

  • 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

  • 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

  • 👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

  • 🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

  • 💵 This position has a base salary range between $80k and $120k USD. The offer varies on many factors including job related knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results.

  • 🎉 Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Your Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a pivotal role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making.

You will design scalable, high-performance data pipelines, ensure data integrity, and drive efficient data processing across the organization. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and implement best practices that empower data-driven decision-making at scale.

This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you build what comes next. As LIQID scales beyond €4 billion in assets under management, the demands on our data infrastructure are growing fast. You will have real ownership over how we meet that challenge, with the autonomy to propose solutions and the backing to ship them.

 

What will keep you challenged?

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure efficient, secure, and reliable data processing from source systems to our data warehouse

  • Develop and manage ETL/ELT workflows to integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring seamless ingestion, transformation, and availability

  • Implement and enforce data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to guarantee accuracy and integrity for analytics and operational use cases

  • Ensure data security and compliance by applying best practices and industry standards for handling sensitive information

  • Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions that unlock new insights

  • Continuously evaluate and integrate new technologies to improve scalability, performance, and future-proof LIQID’s data infrastructure


What you bring

  • Over 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a similar data related role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python and ETL/ELT frameworks, with experience in data modelling, warehousing, and database management (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL)

  • Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and modern data pipeline tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt)

  • Solid understanding of data modelling principles to meet data governance, security, and compliance best practices and ensure safe and scalable data operations

  • FinTech experience is a plus, but a strong interest in financial services and data-driven decision-making is essential

  • Experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to speed up development and integrating them into standard workflows (code review, CI/CD), with the judgment to verify output, not just ship it.

  • Experience with data quality testing frameworks or rules-as-code approaches (e.g. dbt tests, Great Expectations) to catch issues before they hit production.

  • Experience with streaming/near-real-time pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) is a plus.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus


What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget of €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.


What happens next

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

  1. Initial Call with our Talent Partner: A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

  2. Video Interview with Head of Data: You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

  3. Technical Assessment with two Senior Team Members: A technical exchange to discuss your experience and expertise in relation to the role.

  4. In-Person Meeting: You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our CTO.


About us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €3.5 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

title: Team Lead Software Production Support (m/f/d)
description:
At Quantum Systems, we are redefining the boundaries of autonomous drone technology. We develop and deploy some of the world’s most advanced UAVs, combining highly integrated hardware, embedded software, sensors, compute platforms, and production processes into reliable systems for demanding real-world missions.​

As part of our Software Production Support Team, you will work at the intersection of serial UAV production, embedded software, firmware deployment, production diagnostics, automation, and traceability. You will help ensure that every drone leaving production is equipped with the correct software, firmware, configuration, and documentation needed for safe and reliable operation.​

Between hands-on troubleshooting on the production floor, flashing microcontrollers and compute modules, analyzing system behavior, improving diagnostic workflows, developing production tools, and refining digital work instructions, you will play a key role in turning advanced UAV technology into stable, scalable, and efficient serial production



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Leading and developing the Software Production Support team​.

  • Prioritizing urgent production support topics and long-term improvement activities​.

  • Identifying bottlenecks, recurring issues, and process weaknesses in serial production​.

  • Defining robust processes for microcontroller flashing, NVIDIA Orin installation, firmware updates, diagnostics, and recovery workflows​.

  • Driving automation and standardization of software-related production steps​.

  • Ensuring that production tools are reliable, versioned, documented, and maintainable​.

  • Defining requirements for production traceability and digital paper trail documentation​.

  • Coordinating software-related production escalations with Engineering, Quality, and Industrialization​.

  • Ensuring that Operations1 work instructions are technically correct and reflect the real production process​.

  • Monitoring KPIs such as production downtime, flashing success rate, recurring issues, and software-related first-pass yield​.

  • Turning production issues into sustainable process, tooling, or engineering improvements.



What you bring to the team:

  • Several years of experience in embedded systems, production software, manufacturing test, industrialization, or technical production support​.

  • Experience in serial production or manufacturing environments​.

  • Strong understanding of embedded software, firmware flashing, production diagnostics, and system integration​.

  • Experience with Linux-based embedded systems, ideally NVIDIA Jetson / Orin or similar platforms​.

  • Hands-on experience with scripting, automation, production tooling, and diagnostic workflows​.

  • Ability to analyze complex issues across software, electronics, tooling, process, and operator interaction​.

  • Experience coordinating or leading technical teams​.

  • Strong communication skills across production operators, engineers, quality teams, and management​.

  • A structured, hands-on mindset with the ability to distinguish one-off production issues from systemic process weaknesses​.

  • Ideally, experience in drones, robotics, aerospace, automotive, defense, or industrial electronics​.

  • Ideally, knowledge of CAN, UART, Ethernet, USB, SWD, JTAG, I2C, SPI, MES, ERP, traceability systems, or Operations1.

Analyst Early Stage Investment Team (m/f/d) - Berlin, Munich, London

HV Capital is one of Europe's largest generalist VCs. We invest from pre-seed through growth, across SaaS, fintech, deep tech, and beyond. This is a seat inside the investment team, working directly with partners on sourcing, diligence, and portfolio support.

What you'll actually work on

Finding the next companies before anyone else does. Building market maps in sectors we're excited about, sourcing directly instead of waiting for inbound, running comps, and going deep enough on a space that you know it better than the partner sitting next to you.

Running real diligence. Talking to founders, customers, and competitors. Building the model, not just filling in someone else's template. Stress-testing a business case instead of taking the deck at face value. Writing memos that make a case a partner would actually defend in an investment committee.

Forming your own view, and holding it. We're still making bets on people as much as products, and that means judgment: reading a founder, reading a room, deciding whether you'd trust this person with your own money. That's a muscle, not a checklist.

Sitting in the room, eventually. Partner meetings and deal reviews once you've earned it; not to run them, but to watch how a real investment decision actually gets made, and to have a sharp, well-formed view ready when someone asks for yours.

Portfolio support. The odd KPI request, board-prep question, or research ask from a founder who needs a sharp answer fast, not a polished deck in two weeks.

What good looks like here

We evaluate analysts on judgment and reasoning (can you form an independent view and defend it under pushback), commercial acumen (do you actually understand what makes a business work), deal execution (can you run a process end to end from sourcing, modeling, diligence to closing support), and how you show up in the room. Ownership and curiosity matter as much as any of that. Chasing a thread nobody assigned you, following through without being asked twice.

The craft still matters. A clean model, a memo that holds up, a process run properly. That's the baseline, not optional. What increasingly separates a good analyst from a great one on top of that is judgment: forming a view nobody handed you, and holding it under pushback.

What we're looking for

At least 2 -3 years of real work experience. Beyond that, we don't have one template. We've hired from strategy consulting, banking, asset management, the sciences, and straight out of operating roles at startups. ARR, Umsatz, GMV. Das sind die Kennzahlen, an denen sich unser Management und unsere Shareholder orientieren. Du hast ein echtes End-to-End-Verständnis davon, wie Daten aus den Quellsystemen über das Data Warehouse bis ins Reporting gelangen. Dadurch kannst du unterscheiden, ob die Ursache eines Problems in den Daten, im Prozess oder in der Definition liegt. Du erkennst, wann ein Problem an der Quelle behoben werden muss, anstatt es lediglich im Reporting zu korrigieren. Gleichzeitig kannst du einen umfangreichen, laufenden Backlog eigenständig priorisieren und vom ersten Tag an selbstständig bearbeiten, ohne engmaschige Steuerung zu benötigen.   • Wissenstransfer: Du teilst Workflows, Logiken und Arbeitsweisen mit dem Team. So stellst du sicher, dass die von dir etablierten Standards nicht nur bei dir liegen, sondern nachhaltig im gesamten Team verankert werden.

  • SQL ist ein zentraler Bestandteil dieser Rolle und kein Nice-to-have. Du bist sicher darin, komplexe Logiken innerhalb eines mehrschichtigen Data Warehouses zu lesen, zu schreiben und zu debuggen. Dabei denkst du in Datenmodellen und übergreifenden Zusammenhängen, anstatt dich ausschließlich auf einzelne Queries zu konzentrieren.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Finance oder anderen Business-Stakeholdern. SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our in-house hardware onto the Android platform for the first time. The team works closely with hardware, software, and QA engineers across the bring-up process, so this role offers a rare chance to shape a product's foundations while working alongside experienced embedded and secure processor leads.

  • Experience developing embedded systems with a strong focus on Android OS, gained over several years in a professional setting
  • Strong knowledge of the Android OS architecture, from bootloader (U-Boot, Little Kernel) and kernel through to framework and services
  • Hands-on experience debugging hardware interfaces at protocol level, including I2C, SPI, UART, and SDIO

title: Operations Manager
description:

We believe that sustainable nutrition is one of the defining challenges of our generation. Our mission is to make healthy, fresh food accessible everywhere while fundamentally transforming the economics and environmental impact of food production.

Since launching our first products, we have successfully proven the concept, built a talented team, and established strong market traction. We are now entering the next phase of growth.

To support this next stage, we are looking for an experienced, pragmatic and hands-on Operations Manager.

Tasks

You will play a key role in building and scaling our hardware production. You will be responsible for the interface between product development, manufacturing, suppliers, purchasing, quality, inventory and management.

Your goal is to transform our production from small-series manufacturing into a predictable, efficient and quality-controlled serial production setup. This role is not only about coordination, but also about industrialization, cost optimization, process development, supplier management and continuous improvement.

Your responsibilities include:

1. Strategic Management & Optimization

  • Operational leadership, with a focus on production and supplier management
  • Scaling our production from one to multiple locations
  • Ensuring high quality and targeting zero down time in our fleet
  • Setting up a near to perfect quality control system after production

2. Financial Planning & Management

  • Oversight of the financials including budgeting and controlling
  • Optimization of purchasing conditions and cost management
  • Ensuring financial stability while scaling
  • Setup of a clear KPI driven reporting

3. Support Customer Growth

  • Improvement of coordination and execution of our services for B2B clients
  • Building efficient processes to ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction

4. Team & Collaboration

  • Building and leading a high-performing team across all fields
  • Close collaboration with CEO & CTO to achieve strategic goals
  • Direct responsibility with decision-making authority at the highest level
  • You will work closely with the founding team and management, ensuring short communication paths and fast decision-making.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • You have done it before. Experience in operations (COO / Co-Founding a company are welcome) that scaled a business to at least 7-figure revenue
  • Experience with physical products and manufacturing them at scale
  • Strong expertise in cost management, and operational efficiency
  • A highly entrepreneurial mindset combined with a hands-on attitude
  • Ability to achieve ambitious goals with limited resources and lean teams
  • Passion for sustainable innovation and long-term commitment to the company’s vision
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to inspire and lead people
  • You know how to use various AI tools to increase productivity and strategy

You do not need to know all the answers on Day 1. But you need to know how to find the answers, how to build the system that creates the results we want.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • A core leadership role with significant responsibility and decision-making authority
  • An attractive salary and equity package
  • A modern working environment at the pulse of times
  • The opportunity to work on solving a real, meaningful problem
  • The chance to actively shape our vision and sustainably build a growing company
  • A culture of openness, creativity, and collaboration
  • A dynamic environment that enables fast decision-making and flexibility

description:

Beschäftigungsart: Vollzeit, unbefristet
Start: ab sofort – wir warten nicht auf das nächste Quartal

Über reisewitz

reisewitz entwickelt seit 1984 intelligente Planungssoftware und ist europaweit für seine Kunden im Einsatz. Mit adelo® (Tourenplanung & Workforce Management), optaflow® (mobile Zählerkommunikation) und aures (automatische Disposition) steuern über 150 Kunden ihre Serviceteams – darunter Hardeck, BoConcept, Wiener Netze und zahlreiche Stadtwerke. Wir sind ISO 27001 zertifiziert und wurden 2024 mit dem Sust-Award für nachhaltige Routenplanung ausgezeichnet.

Unsere Software liefern wir nicht als Datenträger aus, sondern als Service — wir hosten sie selbst.

Deine Mission

Du betreust unser Hosting-Geschäft — als die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt, mit klar abgegrenztem Verantwortungsbereich und direktem Draht zum CIO. Die Plattform, auf der unsere Kunden täglich ihre Touren planen und ihre Monteure steuern, läuft auf Infrastruktur, die du verantwortest: eine wachsende Hetzner-VPS-Landschaft, unsere Virtualisierungsumgebungen samt Firewall sowie die dazugehörigen Netz-, Storage- und Backup-Schichten.

Dabei stehst du nicht vor einer fertigen Landschaft: Die Migration von VMware auf Proxmox VE ist beschlossen und startet gerade — du begleitest sie mit und übernimmst danach den operativen Betrieb des Clusters. Wie die Zielplattform im Detail aussieht (Storage, HA, Backup-Domäne, Automatisierung), prägst du fachlich mit.

Wenn du Lust darauf hast, wächst die Rolle mittelfristig um eine Beratungs-Komponente: Unterstützung unserer Kunden bei deren eigenen Proxmox- und Hosting-Vorhaben — Architektur, Migration, Schulung.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

Das erste halbe Jahr — Übernahme

  • Übernahme des laufenden Betriebs unserer Hetzner-VPS-Infrastruktur: Provisionierung, Patching, Härtung, Monitoring, Kostenkontrolle.

  • Belastbarer Überblick über Virtualisierung, Storage, Netz und Firewall — inklusive Dokumentation dessen, was heute nur in Köpfen existiert.

  • Ehrliche Bestandsaufnahme der Backup-Lage: Was ist wirklich wiederherstellbar? Der erste echte Restore-Test ist dein Projekt.

  • Erste Anlaufstelle für den Infrastrukturbetrieb — der Eskalationspfad läuft ab dann über dich, nicht mehr über den CIO.

Danach — Migration & Ausbau

  • Begleitung der VMware→Proxmox-Migration und nach Abschluss operative Verantwortung für den Cluster: Pflege, Updates, Storage- und Netzwerkkonfiguration.

  • Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Umgebungen, in denen unsere SaaS-Plattform für über 150 Kunden läuft: Kapazitätsplanung, Performance, Verfügbarkeit.

  • Aufsetzen neuer Kundenumgebungen und deren Lifecycle — vom Onboarding bis zur Stilllegung.

  • Aufbau einer Infrastructure-as-Code-Basis (Terraform für Provisionierung, Ansible für Konfiguration) — weg von handgepflegten Servern, hin zu versionierten Umgebungen.

  • Aufbau einer ernsthaften Backup- und Restore-Disziplin: Konzepte, regelmäßige Restore-Tests, unveränderliche Backups, saubere Trennung der Backup-Domäne. Ransomware-Resilienz ist hier kein Buzzword, sondern Auftrag.

  • Härtung und Absicherung der Systeme im Rahmen unserer ISO-27001-Anforderungen; Pflege von Betriebshandbüchern, Runbooks und Notfall-Dokumentation.

  • Mitgestaltung unserer DevOps-Umgebung: Deployments, Container, Monitoring und Logging.

  • Mitbetreuung der bestehenden Windows-Server-Landschaft und Mitarbeit an deren schrittweiser Modernisierung.

  • Mitwirkung im 2nd-/3rd-Level-Support bei komplexen Server- und Applikationsthemen.

Perspektive (optional, wenn du Lust darauf hast)

  • Beratung unserer Kunden bei Planung und Architektur ihrer eigenen Proxmox- und Hosting-Umgebungen: HA- und Storage-Konzepte (Ceph, ZFS), Migrationen aus VMware oder Hyper-V, Konzeptpapiere und Schulungen.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Gehalt: 58.000 – 72.000 € brutto/Jahr, je nach Erfahrung und Tiefe — deine Einordnung besprechen wir offen und transparent im Bewerbungsgespräch.

  • Volle Verantwortung ab Tag eins und direkter Draht zum CIO. Kurze Wege, keine Eskalationsstufen, keine Gremien.

  • Echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeit: Du baust die Proxmox- und Hosting-Plattform mit auf, statt fertige Strukturen zu verwalten. Die Architektur-Entscheidungen der nächsten Jahre triffst du mit.

  • Voll remote oder hybrid mit Office in Bad Lippspringe — du entscheidest, was zu deinem Leben passt.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Gleitzeit, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksame Leistungen.

  • Modernes Equipment deiner Wahl.

  • Begleite und gestalte die KI-Transformation unseres Unternehmens aktiv mit.

  • Weiterbildungsbudget und Zertifizierungen — inklusive Entwicklungspfad in eine Beratungsrolle.

  • Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Vertrag in einem etablierten Unternehmen (seit 1984), 25 Mitarbeitende, ausgezeichnet als familienfreundlicher Arbeitgeber im Kreis Paderborn.

  • Extras: Sportnavi (Firmenfitness), Corporate Benefits, Getränke im Büro, 1x pro Woche gemeinsames Mittagessen.

Klingt das nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung — Lebenslauf reicht, kein Anschreiben-Roman. Schreib uns nur zwei Dinge dazu:

  1. Welche Infrastruktur du zuletzt verantwortet hast.

  2. Ab wann du starten könntest.

Wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden und führen das Erstgespräch per Video — unkompliziert und ohne Assessment-Center.
